items.default_message: The request payload failed validation.
items.remediation: Inspect the error.fields map to discover which keys failed validation and why.

items.default_message: A valid API token is required for this endpoint.
items.remediation: Send the request with an Authorization: Bearer <sbt_...> header using a token minted at /settings/tokens.

items.default_message: The presented API token does not carry the ability required to perform this action.
items.remediation: Mint a new token including the ability listed in error.required_ability, or ask the team owner to grant it.

items.default_message: The requested resource does not belong to the team this API token is scoped to.
items.remediation: Use a token minted for the correct team, or switch the creator's current team before minting.

items.default_message: The requested resource could not be found.
items.remediation: Double-check the UUID in the path. The resource may have been deleted or never existed.

items.default_message: The plan currency is not supported by the chosen payment provider.
items.remediation: Change the plan currency to one supported by the provider, or enable a provider that supports the plan currency.

items.default_message: The chosen payment provider does not support the billing cycle on this plan.
items.remediation: Choose a billing cycle supported by every provider the plan is offered on, or drop the unsupported provider from the plan.

items.default_message: The project has no payment method configured for the chosen provider.
items.remediation: Configure the missing payment method on the project's Payment Methods page before publishing the plan.

items.default_message: The subscriber already holds an active subscription on this project.
items.remediation: Cancel the existing subscription first, or update its plan instead of creating a new one.

items.default_message: The supplied access code is not recognised.
items.remediation: Verify the code is spelled correctly and belongs to this project. Codes are case-sensitive.

items.default_message: The supplied access code has already expired.
items.remediation: Generate a new batch of access codes with a fresh expiry window.

items.default_message: The supplied access code has already been redeemed.
items.remediation: Access codes are single-use. Generate a new code for the subscriber.

items.default_message: The creator's monthly access-code generation cap has been exceeded.
items.remediation: Upgrade the creator's tier to unlock a higher access-code quota, or wait until the next cycle.

items.default_message: An Idempotency-Key header is required on this endpoint.
items.remediation: Re-send the request with Idempotency-Key: <uuid>; every mutation endpoint requires one.

items.default_message: The supplied Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.
items.remediation: Choose a fresh Idempotency-Key per distinct operation. The server caches responses for 24h per key.

items.default_message: A prior request with the same Idempotency-Key is still in flight.
items.remediation: Wait a few seconds and retry; the original request has not yet finished.

items.default_message: That HTTP method is not supported by this endpoint.
items.remediation: Check the endpoint reference for the verbs this path accepts; the Allow header lists them.

items.default_message: The rate limit for this token has been exceeded.
items.remediation: Back off and retry after the time hinted by the Retry-After header.

items.default_message: This operation requires the creator's account to be on the Growth Plan.
items.remediation: Upgrade the creator to the Growth Plan from /settings/billing.

items.default_message: That connector is not one creators may install today.
items.remediation: Read GET /v1/connectors: only a connector whose status is available or beta can be installed.

items.default_message: The connector needs a higher plan on the creator's account: a second connector on the same project needs the Growth Plan, and a connector reserved for a paid tier needs that tier or higher.
items.remediation: Upgrade the creator to the Growth Plan from /settings/billing, or uninstall the project's other connector first.

items.default_message: That connector is not installed on this project.
items.remediation: Install the connector on the project first (POST /v1/projects/{project}/connectors/{key}), or read GET /v1/projects/{project}/connectors for what is installed.

items.default_message: That connector is installed on this project but not connected, so it cannot be asked.
items.remediation: Connect the installation from the project's Connectors page, verify it (POST /v1/projects/{project}/connectors/{key}/installation/verify), then retry.

items.default_message: The creator holds no linked account on the connector that has to ask them.
items.remediation: Have the creator link their account on the connector from Settings → Security → Linked accounts in the dashboard, then retry; GET /v1/me/identities lists what is linked.

items.default_message: The configured webhook endpoint did not respond successfully.
items.remediation: Investigate the consumer endpoint. Subscriby will retry per the configured backoff before dead-lettering.

items.default_message: The token holder can see this resource but may not change it.
items.remediation: Only the member who registered the resource, or the team owner, may change it. Ask one of them, or mint the token as that member.

items.default_message: An unexpected error occurred. The incident has been recorded.
items.remediation: Capture the error.request_id and contact support if the problem persists.
